title.narrative: Disaster preparedness & response to urgent needs of conflict and climatic events victims at Kasongo

description.narrative: The disaster preparedness and multisectoral response to the urgent humanitarian needs of the most vulnerable households, victims of armed conflict or extreme climatic events in the provinces of South Kivu and Maniema was carried out by the consortium (Caritas Belgium, CAFOD, Caritas Bukavu and Caritas-Kasongo) under the lead of Caritas Belgium (CIbe) and with funding from DG ECHO; this project was completed at the end of May 2023. In Maniema and Fizi (South Kivu), the project was carried out by CAFOD and its partner Caritas-Kasongo in 4 groups: Ulimba, Nsange, Kanyengele and Basimimbi, with the possibility of extending to other localities/groups experiencing humanitarian crises. Ranging from disaster preparedness to early recovery and rapid response for the victims of several humanitarian crises, a number of activities were carried out, including participatory vulnerability and capacity assessments, the development and support of plans, the establishment and capacity-building of facilitators and other stakeholders, multi-purpose cash transfer assistance for crisis victims, the organisation of market fairs for vulnerable households whose livelihoods have been most affected, the organisation of post-distribution evaluation and monitoring, etc. All the activities carried out were crowned with success.
